cogentanalytics-cogentanalytics:lever:aa.description: Position Summary The Outside Sales & Business Development Representative is responsible for generating new business, strengthening referral relationships, increasing quote conversion, and helping the company grow profitable revenue. This is a full-time, field-based sales role focused on building relationships with commercial accounts, fleet operators, logistics companies, distributors, rental companies, municipalities, and other organizations that own or manage heavy-duty vehicles. The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, accountable, and comfortable turning daily sales activity into measurable results. Success in this role will be measured by qualified opportunities, follow-up discipline, booked jobs, revenue growth, gross profit contribution, and the ability to help the company create more predictable, profitable, and collectible work. Business Development & New Account Growth Identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities across commercial, fleet, rental, municipal, and local business channels. Conduct regular outside sales visits, calls, emails, and follow-up activity to build pipeline and create new opportunities. Develop relationships with decision-makers, influencers, office staff, service managers, fleet managers, and business owners. Promote company value proposition around quality repairs, local accountability, technical expertise, customer service, and convenience. Support growth in commercial and fleet accounts by identifying companies that own, lease, or manage multiple vehicles. Help develop and promote referral programs, fleet inspection opportunities, and other revenue-generating initiatives. Sales Process, Follow-Up & Conversion Follow up on open quotes, lost quotes, referral opportunities, and direct customer inquiries. Track why opportunities are won or lost and identify ways to improve conversion. Coordinate with internal team members to ensure customer expectations, scheduling needs, and job details are communicated clearly. Ensure sales activity turns into measurable outcomes, including booked jobs, revenue, gross profit, and repeat opportunities. Maintain disciplined daily and weekly sales activity, including calls, emails, in-person visits, follow-ups, and reporting. CRM, Reporting & Accountability Use the company’s CRM, sales tracker, or designated system to document prospects, contacts, visits, calls, follow-ups, opportunities, and outcomes. Maintain accurate records of sales activity, account status, quote status, referral source, and next steps. Provide weekly sales updates to leadership, including activity completed, opportunities created, quotes generated, jobs booked, revenue impact, and upcoming priorities. Participate in regular sales huddles and accountability meetings. Build and manage a hotlist of priority prospects and active opportunities. Proven ability to build relationships and generate new business. Strong communication, follow-up, and interpersonal skills. Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a field-based sales role. Organized and able to manage multiple prospects, accounts, and follow-up commitments. Comfortable making calls, sending emails, conducting in-person visits, and asking for business. Ability to track activity and report results consistently. Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation. Willingness to travel locally and regionally throughout the Des Moines and surrounding markets.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:cf1.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Chef Instructor, Pastry at Sur La Table, you are the in-store expert and advocate for all things baking and pastry arts. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in pastry techniques, baking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Pastry plays a key role in inspiring a love for baking while driving sales of bakeware, mixers, and decorating tools through hands-on pastry classes and engaging culinary instruction. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Deliver an exceptional in-store culinary experience focused on pastry and baking classes that reflects Sur La Table’s passion for food, teaching, and high standards, while following the provided recipes and game plans to ensure consistency and quality. · Communicate technical concepts and advanced pastry skills in a clear, encouraging, and approachable manner. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. Sales & Business Performance · Drive sales by upholding kitchen standards, encouraging second class sign-ups through strong customer engagement, and promoting retail items used or featured in class. · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed culinary program goals by delivering exceptional classes that drive customer engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations. · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). You will combine clinical expertise, analytics, education, and strategic thinking to build scalable approaches to clinical insight generation. jobgether-jobgether:lever:8ac2e41d-1fe3-.title: AI Red Team Engineer / AI Security Specialist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:8ac2e41d-1fe3-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Red Team Engineer / AI Security Specialist based in India. This is a high-impact security role focused on identifying and addressing vulnerabilities across enterprise AI systems. You will challenge LLMs, RAG architectures, AI agents, APIs, and integrations to uncover weaknesses before they can be exploited. Your work will span prompt injection, jailbreaks, guardrail bypasses, data leakage, privacy, access control, and unauthorized agent actions. You’ll combine offensive security thinking with practical AI expertise to assess how intelligent systems behave under adversarial conditions. The role also involves automating security testing, documenting findings, and helping drive effective remediation. You’ll work across environments supporting industries such as banking, finance, audit, semiconductor, and technology. This opportunity is ideal for a security-minded engineer who wants to help establish stronger and more resilient standards for enterprise AI. Conduct red-team assessments of LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, AI agents, and other generative AI applications. Test AI systems for prompt injection, jailbreaks, guardrail bypasses, adversarial behavior, and other attack vectors. Identify vulnerabilities involving data leakage, privacy exposure, authentication, authorization, and access controls. Assess AI agents, APIs, and enterprise integrations for unintended or unauthorized actions. Perform hallucination, adversarial robustness, and AI-specific security testing across enterprise AI solutions. Develop and automate repeatable AI security testing methodologies and workflows. Document vulnerabilities clearly, assess their potential impact, and support remediation efforts. Apply established AI security frameworks and best practices to strengthen the resilience of AI-enabled systems. Requirements: 4–10+ years of relevant professional experience in cybersecurity, application security, penetration testing, AI security, or a closely related discipline. Strong hands-on knowledge of LLM and Generative AI security , including AI red teaming and adversarial testing. Experience assessing prompt injection, jailbreaks, RAG architectures, agentic AI systems, and AI guardrails . Solid understanding of API security, penetration testing, cloud security, privacy, and access-control vulnerabilities . Practical programming and automation skills, particularly with Python . Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as the OWASP LLM Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS . Ability to investigate complex AI security issues, think adversarially, and translate technical findings into clear remediation recommendations. Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills. Comfortable working independently across complex technical environments and adapting to rapidly evolving AI security threats. Benefits: Fully remote opportunity open to candidates based in India, with global collaboration. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI security challenges across enterprise environments. Exposure to LLMs, RAG systems, AI agents, cloud platforms, APIs, and emerging AI security technologies. Opportunity to contribute to the security of AI solutions used across banking, finance, audit, semiconductor, and technology sectors. Hands-on experience with AI red teaming, adversarial testing, vulnerability research, and security automation. Opportunity to help shape stronger security practices for rapidly evolving enterprise AI systems. Global, technology-focused environment with opportunities to apply and expand advanced cybersecurity expertise. jobgether-jobgether:lever:bcc7a48a-81b7-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. This is a high-impact data role within a fast-moving AI technology environment, with ownership spanning the full business intelligence stack. You will design and maintain the data infrastructure that powers reliable reporting, analytics, and decision-making across the business. The role combines data engineering, business intelligence, dashboard development, and hands-on analysis. You will work closely with business stakeholders and leadership to understand critical KPIs and turn complex datasets into actionable insights. Your work will directly influence operational priorities, product decisions, and commercial performance. As part of a lean and ambitious team, you will have significant autonomy and the opportunity to shape data practices from the ground up. This position is ideal for a technically strong data professional who combines engineering expertise with commercial awareness and a passion for clear, impactful storytelling. Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines, data warehouse infrastructure, and data lake environments using AWS services. Establish reliable and scalable data flows across business systems while maintaining high standards for data quality, availability, and consistency. Optimise data infrastructure for performance, reliability, scalability, and effective data governance. Develop and maintain data models and transformation processes that support reporting, analytics, and business intelligence use cases. Build high-quality, intuitive, and actionable dashboards in Looker or comparable business intelligence platforms. Work closely with business stakeholders to understand operational requirements, define KPIs, and translate business questions into effective analytical solutions. Explore and analyse datasets to identify trends, patterns, opportunities, and areas for operational or commercial improvement. Partner with leadership to deliver data-driven analysis that supports strategic decision-making and measurable business change. Translate complex analytical findings into clear, concise, and actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences. Continuously improve the data stack, reporting environment, and analytical processes to increase the accessibility and business value of data. Take end-to-end ownership of business intelligence initiatives, from underlying data pipelines through dashboards and actionable insights. Requirements Strong professional experience with Python and SQL, with the ability to develop reliable data transformation and analytical workflows. Hands-on experience with AWS data services, particularly Amazon Redshift, S3, Glue, Athena, and Lambda. Proven ability to design, model, transform, and visualise data effectively. Experience building and maintaining dashboards in Looker or a comparable BI platform. Solid understanding of data warehousing, data lakes, data pipelines, and modern data architecture principles. Ability to work across the data stack and take ownership from data ingestion and transformation through reporting and business analysis. matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:cb6122d7-9b0.description: Match Group AI Team Introduction Match Group AI (MG AI) is the central tech organization that drives innovation across Match Group’s global portfolio, including Tinder, Hinge, Azar, Pairs, Match, BLK, etc. Our mission is to solve the most complex challenges in online dating (e.g., Recommendation, Trust & Safety, Profile Enhancement) by bridging cutting-edge AI research with excellent software engineering. Unlike brand-specific teams (e.g., Tinder, HYPERCONNECT AI), MG AI team offers the unique opportunity to impact the entire Match Group ecosystem. You won't just build for one app; we aim to develop scalable AI solutions that power Tinder, Hinge, and beyond, defining the technological gold standard for the global dating industry. Detailed article: Introduction to Match Group AI Team (written in Korean) Working as a MLSE at MG AI While ML Engineers focus on modeling, Machine Learning Software Engineers (MLSEs) at MG AI team focus on the critical bridge between research and production. We ensure that state-of-the-art models (including LLMs and Multimodal systems) are integrated into high-traffic environments, serving millions of users in real-time. We also upload a selection of interesting problems solved by our team's engineers to the Hyperconnect Tech blog (written in Korean). weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:41e24db7-d93.title: Brazilian Portuguese Patent Language Lead
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:41e24db7-d93.description: Park IP, a Welo Global brand, is a global IP solutions partner built for modern intellectual property work. The company enables legal teams to protect intellectual assets with accuracy, clarity, and confidence across jurisdictions. Trusted by Am Law 200 firms and Fortune 500 corporate legal departments, Park IP combines deep IP expertise with AI-powered workflows that reduce risk, improve predictability, and deliver greater visibility and control across the IP lifecycle, from prosecution to litigation and compliance. Its Legal Studio platform strengthens portfolio management through jurisdiction-specific coordination and real-time oversight, while experienced IP professionals remain accountable for quality and judgment. Operating under ISO-aligned quality and security standards, Park IP advances a disciplined and transparent approach to managing intellectual property worldwide. parkip.com MAIN PUROPOSE OF JOB The Brazilian Portuguese Patent Language Lead is a critical position that requires a strong background in translation, localization, and copy-editing tasks with a focus on patent/legal documents. This professional is responsible for translating, copy editing or reviewing complex patent/legal materials from English into Brazilian Portuguese, ensuring the highest quality and accuracy of the deliverables to client. This role works closely with Quality, Program Squads, Talent, vendors and other stakeholders to provide precise language support for patent-related matters. This professional ensures that the expected level of translation quality is maintained, and the product delivered to the client should always meet its intended purpose, while closely monitoring that translation expenses remain within budget. The Brazilian Portuguese Patent Language Lead understands legal requirements and engages the production team in the fulfillment of these requirements, crafting client solutions based on the Welo Global Four Pillars of Customer Service, Quality, Innovation and Global Teamwork.
